author: agent
statement: A TypeScript replay evaluated FIFO, oldest-release, and highest-priority Probe dispatch across all five locked cases. Each policy redistributed the first busy-wave order from 01,02,04,05,03,06 to 01,02,03,04,05,06 and reduced the maximum Probe wait from 22.000 s to 9.667 s, but exact Probe queue remained 33.932 s and total tracked-lot queue remained 77.909 s. dram-lot-03 packaging service advanced 24.150 s and Burn-in completion advanced 23.000 s while lots 04 and 05 were correspondingly delayed. Every aggregate/current-case score, delivery count and mix, WIP, mean cycle and queue, quality outcome, final dram-lot-07 WIP identity, cost, and area remained unchanged in all five cases.
